if: the document is a refund voucher referred to in clause (e) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 51 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the refund voucher MUST carry the recipient's name, address and GSTIN or Unique Identity Number, where the recipient is registered
note: One mandatory particular of rule 51(d), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number or Unique Identity Number, if registered, of the recipient;
